title: New star of Romanian swimming Daria Silișteanu wins second gold at Dakar 2026 Summer Youth Olympic Games
summary: Romanian 17-year-old swimmer Daria Silișteanu won another gold medal at the Youth Olympic Games in Dakar (Senegal) on Thursday, November 5, in the 50-meter backstroke event. The Romanian finished the race at 27.93 seconds, while South Korea's Seungwon Kim came second with a time of 28.21 seconds. The medal is Silișteanu’s second Olympic gold and her third medal at this competition. Her time represents a national record in the 17, 18, and 19+ age categories, according to the Romanian Olympic and Sports Committee (COSR).
